node.statement: One-factor estimate. Using tilde-Phi_n tilde-Delta_n=tilde-Delta_n, the exact identity Phi_n Delta_n-Delta_n=(Phi_n-tilde-Phi_n)tilde-Delta_n+Phi_n(Delta_n-tilde-Delta_n)+(tilde-Delta_n-Delta_n) holds. Lem-routef-functional-calculus-closeness bounds the first map difference by C_theta eta, lem-routef-delta-normalization-closeness bounds ||Delta-tilde-Delta||_cb by C_Delta eta, Phi is completely contractive, and ||tilde-Delta||_cb<=2. Therefore for every T, ||Phi_n(Delta_n T)-Delta_n T||<=[2C_theta+C_Delta+C_Delta]eta||T||=2(C_theta+C_Delta)eta||T||=d||T||.
